title: [text] truncate: a negative limit returns text longer than the limit
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceAI-Workspace

in truncate in src/text.ts: replace return text.slice(0, maxLength) with text.slice(0, Math.max(0, maxLength))
- truncate("abc", -1) is ""
- truncate("abc", 1) is "a"
- truncate("abc", 0) is ""

(Builder pre-file, MODIFY_BODY, public-replace-expression-v2): Peace's task (source: peace). Bug: truncate("abc", -1) returns "ab", longer than the limit, because slice(0, -1) counts from the end. Self-zone task on PeaceAI-Workspace: one expression in src/text.ts plus one new src/*.test.ts file. A box dry-run on PeaceAI-Workspace c7ba0a5 (Node 22) built no candidate. Expected: refused today (src/text.ts is not in the replace rule's EDITABLE_PATHS).)
